about.description: AB1 is tokenized ordinary equity of Animoca Brands Corporation Limited, the Hong Kong-based Web3 investment group, issued by Republic on Solana. Underlying book-entry shares are custodied by BitGo Bank & Trust and tokens trade on Republic's regulated secondary marketplace through the INX ATS with KYC required. Holders own real Animoca Brands equity in digital form. Supply grows as existing shareholders opt in to tokenize. The on-chain holder base is a small closed cap table with transfer-hook whitelisting.
about.registryInfo: Tokenization by Republic (OpenDeal group, New York, CIK 0001794805). Underlying book-entry ordinary shares of Animoca Brands Corporation Limited (Australian-incorporated, ex-ASX:AB1, delisted 2020) custodied by BitGo Bank & Trust (OCC-regulated); secondary trading via INX Securities LLC (SEC-registered broker-dealer, FINRA/SIPC, ATS).
